## Context / Problem

The epic needs one option selecting the plan-review engine (pipeline or agentic) so both can run on one ticket. `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml` has no selection point today.

## Approach

**Key.** Add the key ADR 0123 records, `[verify] plan_review_engine`, values `"pipeline"` and `"agentic"`, default `"pipeline"`. Declare it in `src/rebar/_config_schema.py` beside `require_plan_review_for_close` (line 71) as `plan_review_engine: str = _documented("pipeline", ...)`, and validate it in `src/rebar/_config_sections.py`'s `_SECTIONS["verify"]` with the existing `_as_choice(v, k, {"pipeline", "agentic"})` (pattern at line 95), so an unknown configured value is a config error at load time. `# mechanism-ok: config_key verify.plan_review_engine — bossy-impish-hoiho` sits directly above that `_SECTIONS` entry (the detector reads only that line and the one above, `scripts/_mechanism_delta/markers.py:76-83`), as at line 92.

**No env var.** ADR 0123 forbids one, but every `_SECTIONS` key gets `REBAR_<SECTION>_<KEY>` automatically. `_config_sources.py` adds `_ENV_EXCLUDED_KEYS = frozenset({("verify", "plan_review_engine")})` and helper `env_overridable_keys()` (each `_SECTIONS` pair not in it). Every canonical-env enumeration switches to it: `env_overrides` (`_config_sources.py:331`), the config cache signature (`config.py:381`), `scripts/gen_env_registry.py:409`, `scripts/generate_config_surface_golden.py:49-53`, and the derived-set tests `tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py:302` and `tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py:39`. So `REBAR_VERIFY_PLAN_REVIEW_ENGINE` is never read, documented or expected; the sunset ticket removes the entry.

**Resolution.** `review_plan` (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:199`) gains a keyword `engine: str | None = None`. Precedence per the ADR: an explicit argument, else the config key, else `"pipeline"`. An explicit value outside the two names raises `ConfigError` naming it before any store read or LLM call. CLI/MCP flags belong to the surfaces ticket.

**Dispatch.** `review_plan` passes the resolved value to `_run_plan_review` (call at `__init__.py:273`, which gains an `engine` keyword). `gate_dispatch.produce_plan_review_verdict` (`gate_dispatch.py:66`) gains `engine: str = "pipeline"`, mirroring `overlap: bool = False` (line 75), always placed in the `run_workflow` inputs (line 191); `_run_plan_review` passes it at line 522. Existing callers and tests keep the default.

**Pipeline-only shortcuts.** Three steps in `_run_plan_review` return before dispatch and are pipeline-attestation based: `reuse.idempotent_reuse` (line 473), `reuse.verdict_reuse` (line 480) and `orchestrator.drift_refresh` (line 490, whose probe calls `produce_plan_review_verdict` at `orchestrator.py:499` and re-signs). Each existing `if` gains `engine == "pipeline" and`, so under `"agentic"` none can return a reused or re-signed pipeline verdict or make a pipeline LLM call. Boolean operands add no McCabe branch (`_run_plan_review` stays 17, ceiling 19).

**Workflow selection.** The v3 expression grammar accepts only single references (`lint_expr.py`; no `==`/`&&`), so a deterministic step computes it, like `grounding` → `code_grounded`:

- `plan-review.yaml` declares input `engine` (string, default `"pipeline"`).
- New top-level step `engine_route` (`needs: [precheck]`) uses new scripted op `plan_review_engine_route` in `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py`, inputs `run_llm: ${{ steps.precheck.outputs.run_llm }}` and `engine: ${{ inputs.engine }}`. It emits one boolean, `run_pipeline = run_llm and engine == "pipeline"`.
- The `review` branch (line 56) changes its condition from `steps.precheck.outputs.run_llm` to `${{ steps.engine_route.outputs.run_pipeline }}` and gains `engine_route` in `needs`. Its `then` arm and its `else` passthrough arm are unchanged.

**Floor first, no silent passthrough.** Not-claimable tickets fast-fail at `__init__.py:398-400`; a floor block or exempt type sets `run_llm` false, so the passthrough emits the precheck verdict under both values, byte-identical, no LLM call. With `run_llm` true and `"agentic"`, `plan_review_engine_route` raises naming the value (engine not yet available); the failed run takes the existing failed-run path to an unsigned INDETERMINATE carrying that error, never a passthrough verdict. The agentic-engine ticket replaces the raise with its arm.

## Scope

- rebar.toml (`[verify] plan_review_engine = "pipeline"`, commented)
- src/rebar/_config_schema.py (field)
- src/rebar/_config_sections.py (validation + marker)
- src/rebar/_config_sources.py (`_ENV_EXCLUDED_KEYS`, `env_overridable_keys`)
- src/rebar/config.py (cache signature loop)
- scripts/gen_env_registry.py, scripts/generate_config_surface_golden.py, tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py, tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py (use the helper)
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py (engine argument, resolution, shortcut guards)
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py (`engine` keyword; 778 lines, adds under 10)
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml (input, `engine_route`, condition)
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py (`plan_review_engine_route` op)
- src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_engine_route_input.schema.json (new)
- src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_engine_route_output.schema.json (new)
- src/rebar/schemas/__init__.py (register beside `plan_review_grounding`, line 289)
- tests/unit/test_plan_review_workflow_ops_seam.py (`_EXPECTED_OPS` gains the new op)
- docs/config.md (narrative entry for the key)
- docs/config-reference.md, docs/env-vars.md, tests/golden/config_surface.json (regenerated)
- tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py (new)

## Testing

- Happy path: no key or `"pipeline"` runs the pipeline; explicit `engine="pipeline"` beats a configured `"agentic"`; `produce_plan_review_verdict` defaults the input to `"pipeline"`.
- Shortcuts: with a valid pipeline attestation, with a stored matching BLOCK, and with a code-drift-only stale attestation, `engine="agentic"` (`sign=True`) still returns the unsigned INDETERMINATE with zero LLM calls; under `"pipeline"` each shortcut still fires.
- Route op: `run_pipeline` true only for `run_llm=true, engine="pipeline"`; false when `run_llm=false` under both; raises naming the value for `run_llm=true, engine="agentic"`.
- Env: `REBAR_VERIFY_PLAN_REVIEW_ENGINE=agentic` exported, no key: engine stays `"pipeline"`; env-vars doc and golden omit the name.
- Failure/edge: unknown configured value → load error naming it; unknown argument → `ConfigError`, zero LLM calls; floor-blocked and not-claimable tickets: zero LLM calls under both values (`FakeRunner`, `runner.py:194`, call counts), identical verdict and findings; DET-passing under `"agentic"` → unsigned INDETERMINATE naming the engine, never the passthrough verdict.
- The gate workflow lints clean.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `[verify] plan_review_engine` is read with default `"pipeline"`, explicit-argument precedence, no environment override, and an error on unknown configured or explicit values; pinned by `tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py`.
- [ ] Floor-blocked and not-claimable reviews make zero LLM calls and return identical results under both values, and a DET-passing review under `"agentic"` returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE naming the engine with zero LLM calls, including when a valid, BLOCK-reusable or drift-stale pipeline attestation exists; pinned by call-counting tests in the same file.
- [ ] `produce_plan_review_verdict` defaults `engine` to `"pipeline"`, so the drift-refresh probe and existing callers are unchanged; pinned by a test asserting the workflow input.
- [ ] `docs/config-reference.md`, `docs/env-vars.md` and `tests/golden/config_surface.json` are regenerated and their drift checks pass.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0 with the marker naming the open sunset ticket.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
